title: Cost-Efficient Whole Genome Sequencing for Outbreak Detection in Hospitals
author: Kady Waggle
materials: De-identify and log isolates into database.
Starting material: plates from steps 3.6 and 4.18
Start pre-saved "MM_Ultra2_Bac_Yeast_Blood" program on KingFisher Apex instrument. Program provided by ThermoFisher.

When instructed (about 20 min into the run), remove sample plate and add 40µL Enhancer Solution (ThermoFisher A36583) to the bottom of each well containing a sample, and 40µL Proteinase K (ThermoFisher A36578) to the top of each well containing a sample.
Divide TSB reagent evenly into an 8-tube strip.
Wait until liquid is clear (3 min).
Without disturbing the beads, remove and discard supernatant.
Quantify each library pool concentration using a dsDNA High Sensitivity Qubit Kit (ThermoFisher Q32854).
Spike DNA library pool with 4% PhiX (NextSeq1000).
Load libraries and reagents into appropriate instrument.
Start pre-saved "MM_Ultra2_Bac_Yeast_Blood" program on KingFisher Apex instrument. Program provided by ThermoFisher.

steps.title: Generate Collection List
steps.instruction: Generate a list of select high-concern pathogens meeting collection criteria twice per week using Theradoc (v5.4.0.HF1.102).

steps.title: Isolate Bacteria from Agar Plates
steps.instruction: Locate nutrient agar slants or blood agar plates (BAP) corresponding to the collection list and subculture them.

substeps.instruction: Transfer bacteria from nutrient agar slant or BAP to a fresh BAP using a 1µL loop.
Incubate at 37⁰C with 5% CO2 overnight.
Observe plates for growth and correct morphologies for the expected organism.
Reserve plates for sample preparation and DNA extraction.

steps.title: Isolate Bacteria from Stool Specimens
steps.instruction: Process clinical stool specimens corresponding to the collection list in a biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Streak stool onto cycloserine-cefoxitin-mannitol agar with taurocholate and lysozume (CCMA-TAL) plates using a 10µL loop.
Transfer stool to a 1mL cryovial using a 1mL disposable transfer pipette for long-term storage at -80⁰C (add PBS in 1mL increments if stool is too viscous to pipette).
Transfer inoculated CCMA-TAL plates and additional pre-reduction plates (n=2 per isolate) into a Coy anaerobic chamber via airlock.
Incubate within the anaerobic chamber at 37⁰C for 48h.

steps.title: Perform Prodisc C. diff Screening
steps.instruction: Screen CCMA-TAL plates for C. diff using the Prodisc procedure.

substeps.instruction: Place one Prodisc on the lid of the plate using sterile forceps.
Transfer one colony to two new CCMA-TAL plates (CCMA-TAL_plate1 and CCMA-TAL_plate2) using a 1µL flex loop and incubate in the Coy anaerobic chamber at 37⁰C for 24h-48h.
Place one drop of sterile H2O directly onto the disc using a 1mL disposable transfer pipette.
Add 1 drop (approx 20µL) of cinnamaldehyde reagent to the Prodisc.
Collect bacterial colonies using the wooden end of a sterile swab.
Incubate 2 min at room temperature.
Inoculate the Prodisc by dabbing and rolling the wooden end of the swab on top of the disc.
Incubate 1 min at room temperature.
Observe color change: Pink is C. diff positive; white/yellow is C. diff negative.

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Pellets
steps.instruction: Prepare bacterial samples for DNA extraction based on the screening results.

substeps.instruction: For C. diff positive results (Step 4.17), use a 10µL loop to gather colonies from CCMA-TAL_plate2 and inoculate into a cryovial with 1mL nutrient broth and 20% glycerol for storage at -80⁰C.

Use a 10µL loop to obtain a quarter-portion of bacteria from BAP or a half-portion from C. diff-positive CCMA-TAL_plate1 and inoculate into a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube containing 750µL PBS (Note: use 500µL PBS if proceeding immediately to DNA extraction and omit steps 5.4-6.2).
Centrifuge inoculated microcentrifuge tubes at 6.0× g for 10 min.
Remove and discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Store bacterial pellets at -20⁰C.
Use a new 10µL loop to collect all bacterial colonies from BAP and inoculate into cryovials containing 1mL Nutrient Broth + 20% glycerol for storage at -80⁰C.

steps.title: Extract DNA using KingFisher Apex
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the MagMax DNA Multi-Sample Ultra 2.0 Kit on the KingFisher Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellets (from step 5.6) or use bacterial suspensions (from step 5.2) in 400µL PBS.
Prepare 80% Ethanol (2mL per sample plus overage).
Prepare 50mg/mL lysozyme (ThermoFisher 89833) by resuspending powder in 35% glycerol solution (40µL per sample plus overage).
Prepare 1:10 Binding Bead Mix using Lysis/Binding solution (ThermoFisher A36581) and DNA Binding Beads (ThermoFisher A36579) (440µL per sample plus overage).

Prepare 96-well extraction plates: Wash Plate 1 (1000µL Wash Solution 1, ThermoFisher A36580), Wash Plate 2 (1000µL 80% Ethanol), Wash Plate 3 (1000µL 80% Ethanol), Elution Plate (100µL Elution Solution, ThermoFisher A36582).
Prepare Sample Plate: Add 40µL lysozyme solution to wells, then add 400µL sample per the template.
Place tip comb into deep well plate.
Load plates when prompted and press start.
Approximately 20 min after starting, remove sample plate, invert Binding Bead Solution to mix, and slowly add 440µL Binding Bead Mix to each sample well.
Approximately 30 min after adding bead mix, remove plate and transfer eluted DNA into labeled 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes (store at 4⁰C short term or -20⁰C long term).

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA quantification for each sample using Qubit with the dsDNA broad range assay kit (ThermoFisher Q32853).

steps.title: Perform Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Prepare libraries using the Illumina DNA Prep (M) Tagmentation Kit (Illumina 20060059).

substeps.instruction: Prepare Tagmentation Master Mix (calculate 10% overage), vortex thoroughly, and divide evenly into an 8-tube strip.
Add 1-30µL DNA to each well of a 96-well PCR plate to achieve 100-500ng total; add nuclease-free water to bring total volume to 30µL if DNA volume is < 30µL. Keep samples on ice.
Thaw EPM reagent (from -25 to -15⁰C) on ice and thaw index plate (Illumina DNA/RNA UD Indexes Set A, 20091654) at room temperature.
Add 10µL Tagmentation Master Mix to each sample well using a multichannel pipette.
Spin PCR plate briefly (~3 sec) in a centrifuge.
Place PCR plate on a plate shaker (IKA MS 3) at 1800rpm for 1 min.
Seal plate with 'Microseal B' (Fisher 509010045).
Run the 'TAG' program in the thermal cycler: Preheat lid 100⁰C, reaction volume 40µL, 55⁰C for 15 min, hold at 10⁰C.
Remove plate, spin down briefly (~3 sec), and remove 'Microseal B'.

steps.title: Perform Post-Tagmentation Cycling
steps.instruction: Complete the tagmentation process and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Run the 'PTC' program in the thermal cycler: Preheat lid 100⁰C, reaction volume 50µL, 37⁰C for 15 min, hold at 10⁰C.
Spin down briefly (~3 sec) and shake on plate shaker at 1800 rpm for 1 min.
Seal plate with a new 'Microseal B'.
Add 10µL TSB to each sample well.
Perform first wash: Remove 'Microseal B', place on magnetic stand, remove and discard supernatant (do not disturb beads).

Perform second wash: Remove sample plate from thermal cycler, spin down briefly, seal with Optical Adhesive Film (ThermoFisher 4311971), shake at 1800 rpm for 1 min, remove from magnet, and add 100µL TWB to each well.
Remove and discard supernatant (do not remove after second wash until step 10.2).

steps.title: Amplify Libraries via PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA using the Enhanced PCR Master Mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Enhanced PCR Master Mix (calculate 10% overage), vortex, and spin down.
Remove seal and place plate on magnetic stand.
Remove plate from magnetic stand and immediately add 20µL PCR Master Mix to each sample well.
Spin down briefly, seal with Optical Adhesive Film, and shake at 1800 rpm for 1 min.
Add 5µL of appropriate index adapters to each sample, spin down briefly, seal with Optical Adhesive Film, and shake at 1800 rpm for 1 min.
Run the 'BLT PCR' program: Preheat lid 100⁰C, 68⁰C for 3 min, 98⁰C for 3 min, then (X) cycles of [98⁰C 45 sec, 62⁰C 30 sec, 68⁰C 2 min], 68⁰C for 1 min, hold at 10⁰C.

steps.title: Clean Up Libraries
steps.instruction: Perform size selection and final cleanup of the DNA libraries.

substeps.instruction: Prepare diluted IPB solution and 80% Ethanol (400µL per sample plus overage).
Thaw RSB reagent (from -25⁰C to -15⁰C) and vortex.
Remove sample plate from thermal cycler, centrifuge briefly, and place on magnetic stand for 5 min.
Transfer 20µL supernatant from each sample to a 'midi plate' (Fisher 14-230-244).
Prepare 'size selection' plate (Fisher E0030129504) by adding 15µL undiluted IPB to each well.
Transfer 125µL supernatant from the 'midi plate' to the 'size selection' plate containing IPB; incubate at RT for 5 min.
Seal with Optical Adhesive Film and shake at 1800 rpm for 1 min.
Vortex diluted IPB solution and add 110µL to each sample well.
Place plate on magnetic stand, add 200µL of 80% ethanol, and incubate 30 sec.
Perform two washes: Remove supernatant, place on magnet, and use a 10-20µL multichannel pipette to remove residual ethanol (do not let beads dry).
Remove plate from magnet, add 32µL RSB to beads, and incubate at RT for 2 min.
Seal with Optical Adhesive Film, shake at 1800 rpm for 1 min, place on magnetic stand for 2 min, and transfer 30µL supernatant to a 'final DNA libraries' 96-well PCR plate.

steps.title: Pool and Normalize Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the libraries and normalize concentrations for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Combine 5µL of each library per column into a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube, vortex, and spin down.
Convert Qubit concentrations from ng/µL to nM (use 700bp fragment size or user-determined size).
Normalize each pool to an equimolar concentration using RSB, then vortex and spin down.
Combine 15µL of each library pool into a single 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube for the final DNA library pool.

steps.title: Final Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Verify library quality and load onto the appropriate sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Perform Tapestation using D1000 screen tape on the final library pool to determine fragment size distribution.
Select instrument: NextSeq1000 P1 XLEAP-SBS 300-cycle kit (2x150bp) for 48-72 samples, or NovaSeq X Plus V1 300-cycle kit (2x150bp) for 73-192 samples.
Dilute final library pool to loading concentration: 850pM for NextSeq1000 or 300pM for NovaSeq X Plus.
